## Doubter Findings

FINDING: pagination strategy unspecified
  The endpoint returns 'array of Product' with no bound. offset/limit vs cursor vs page/per_page each imply different contracts and storage semantics. Pick one in the spec.

FINDING: default page size unspecified
  Returning the full table on an unparameterized request will silently break once products grow past a few thousand rows.

FINDING: max page size unspecified
  Without a server-enforced cap, callers can request limit=1000000 and exhaust DB memory.

FINDING: sort order unspecified
  Without a stable ORDER BY, the cursor pages will be non-deterministic and skip/repeat rows across requests.

Recommendation: extend the spec with {pagination: cursor, default_limit: 20, max_limit: 100, order_by: id ASC}.
